headline: Alliant Energy Corp's Dividend Analysis
summary: Alliant Energy Corp (NASDAQ:LNT) recently announced a total dividend of $0.54 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This includes a $0.54 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-17.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
